title: Microsoft Purview: reasoning trace and confidence score for DLP triage agent alerts
summary: Hold: the briefing presents a separate agent identity as universal, but Microsoft documents a choice between an agent identity and the configuring user's identity. It also omits the evidence-collection prerequisite for device alert triage. The roadmap facts and documented control paths otherwise check out; the new fields' default and feature-specific details remain unpublished.
